svg.title: Choosing the base commit for affected detection on main
svg.desc: Three commits on main. X is the last commit whose deploy succeeded, so the API last deployed from X. Commit A changes apps/api, but its deploy run failed on a flaky test. Commit B changes only documentation and is the current run, HEAD. Wrong: with base HEAD^1, which is A, the diff from A to B contains only documentation, so nothing is deployed and the API change in A never ships. Right: with the base set to the last successful deploy, X, the diff from X to B includes apps/api, so the API is rebuilt and deployed and A's change ships. With Nx, the nx-set-shas action finds the last successful run on main; with Turborepo, set TURBO_SCM_BASE; pull requests use the merge base with main. Compare with what is deployed, not with the previous commit.

g.text: Choosing the base on main: compare with the last successful deploy, not HEAD^1
diff A..B is docs only, so nothing deploys, and the api change in A never ships
Right: base = the last successful deploy (X)
diff X..B includes apps/api, so the api is rebuilt and deployed, and A's change ships
Nx: the nx-set-shas action finds the last successful run on main. Turborepo: set TURBO_SCM_BASE.
Pull requests: use the merge base with the target branch.
Compare with what is deployed, not with the previous commit.
